comments.author: chestnut-tree
comments.why: Shows the Elgar piece known as Nimrod in the UK.
comments.text: Interesting. In the UK, the word Nimrod is recognised (if at all) as a piece of classical music by the British composer Edward Elgar (from his work Enigma Variations) [VIDEO]

comments.author: diakritikal
comments.story: 20 Freescale Semiconductor Employees on Missing Flight MH370
comments.why: Evocative Elgar piece shared in a somber moment.
comments.text: This is sad news. I was trying to listen to some cello works and this (the music) popped into my recommendations. Not a huge Elgar fan but Nimrod and many of his pieces are very evocative. Hug your partner and children tonight. [VIDEO]

comments.author: nostrademons
comments.story: Permanent home for Les Paul Google Logo
comments.why: Compares pi's digits to the melody of Nimrod.
comments.text: Pi actually reminds me a bit of "Nimrod" from Elgar's Enigma variations. The opening is only one note off, and then many of the later sequences in pi have the same large jumps that Nimrod does. [VIDEO]
